text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Board of Directors of TO Live under Part H, Section 22, of the Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto Procedures By-law for a term of office ending November 14, 2022, and until a successor is appointed.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Elected Councillor Gary Crawford as Vice Chair of the Board of Directors of TO Live under Part H, Section 22, of the Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto Procedures By-law for a term of office ending November 14, 2022, and until a successor is appointed.
